SUMARRY
Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building highly scalable, test-driven backend systems and production-grade GenAI platforms. Proven expertise in event-driven architectures, message queues, and distributed services, combined with hands-on experience building AI agents, RAG pipelines, and vector-search systems using LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and Qdrant. Focused on reliability, maintainability, and long-term system health.

EXPERIENCE
EPAM Systems Inc. Oct 2023 – Present Senior Software Engineer Noida, India Scalable Backend & Platform • Designed and built highly scalable backend services to support AI-driven customs classification workflows. • Implemented event-driven architectures using RabbitMQ to decouple long-running classification, reporting, and reprocessing jobs. • Defined clear service boundaries and API contracts, improving maintainability and independent service evolution. • Applied TDD for core business logic, writing unit and integration tests to ensure correctness and long- term reliability. GenAI & Agent Systems • Built GenAI-powered agents using LangChain and LangGraph to orchestrate multi-step workflows such as classification, validation, and reporting. • Implemented RAG pipelines using LlamaIndex with Qdrant as a vector database for semantic search over internal knowledge and historical classifications. • Designed prompt strategies and agent routing logic to safely execute backend actions from natural language inputs. • Integrated MCP (Model Context Protocol) to standardize context sharing across tools and agents. Frontend • Built conversational UIs that interact with backend agents via Streaming APIs. • Improved frontend performance with caching, lazy loading, and optimized data-fetching, reducing backend load and improving UX. • Improved frontend performance through caching strategies, lazy loading, and code splitting, resulting in ~10% faster load times and 20% smaller bundles. Tesit Technologies Inc. Feb 2021 – Oct 2023 Software Engineer Remote • Led development of a high-performance PWA using Next.js, achieving 99% Lighthouse performance and 100% SEO. • Designed and built scalable video-processing microservices using Node.js and FFmpeg, supporting ~10k/day users. • Containerized services with Docker and deployed Kubernetes auto-scaling to handle traffic spikes. • Built AI-driven video auto-tagging pipelines using AWS Kinesis, improving content discovery. • Delivered core user experiences including personalized feeds, in-app video editing, and real-time messaging. • Improved developer velocity by creating custom GitHub Actions for CI/CD. Envirya Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Aug 2019 – Feb 2021 Software Engineer Gurgaon, India • Built a custom, reusable form builder in React Native used across multiple projects. • Developed MSME-focused mobile and backend solutions using React Native, Node.js, and MongoDB. • Automated operational workflows using background services and Cron jobs. • Developed RESTful backend services using Node.js to support web and mobile applications.

SKILLS
Backend: Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI, REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSockets Messaging & Async Processing: RabbitMQ, Background Workers, Retry & Idempotency Patterns Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Material UI, Shadcn Testing: TDD, Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, API Testing, Unit & Integration Testing AI & Automation: LangGraph, LangChain, MCP, LlamaIndex, Prompt Engineering, AWS Bedrock Flows Cloud & DevOps: GCP, AWS (Lambda, S3, Bedrock), Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, CI/CD Databases: MongoDB, Qdrant, Semantic Search, Embeddings, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Big Query

Multi-Agent Orchestrator

A LangGraph-based system that routes a request through several specialised
agents instead of sending everything to one model. Ravi built it to handle
support and research queries that need different tools and different context.
How it works

The graph starts at a triage node that classifies the request, then routes to
one or more specialist nodes. Specialists can hand off to each other, and every
node reads and writes a shared memory keyspace so context survives a handoff.
- Conditional edges decide the next node from the triage classification.
- Each specialist exposes its own tool set, so a research agent never sees
  write tools it does not need.
- Shared memory means a follow-up question like "now summarise that" resolves
  against the previous turn without re-fetching.

Why LangGraph

Plain LangChain chains cannot express cycles or conditional branching, and
supervisor patterns need hand-written routing. LangGraph models the whole thing
as a state machine, which made the routing explicit and testable.
Stack

Python, LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI, PostgreSQL for checkpointing.
